## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D room-based RPG for phones and tablets, with enemies, equipment upgrades, and accessories.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Support responsive touch controls for phones and tablets.
